teacherNote: Marked against: Splitting the middle term −7x as −6x − x (1); Factoring by grouping to obtain (2x − 1)(x − 3) = 0 (1); Solving factors to determine roots x = 1/2 and x = 3 (1). Good understanding of the factorisation method and correct middle-term splitting. Be careful when factoring out negative signs: taking common from −x + 3 yields −1(x − 3), which gives the root x = 1/2 instead of −1/2.
